studies.name: Local and circulating cytotoxic CD4 T cells are early markers of disease activity in pediatric Crohns Disease: all cells
studies.description: Data from the PREDICT study (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT03369353) For the scientific article about cytotoxic CD4 T cells. This study contains the integrated all-cell gut dataset used in Figure 4, including all cell types and all tissues present in the supplied object (1,006,165 cells). It integrates PREDICT 3-prime and 5-prime data with terminal ileum cells from Thomas et al. (2024): https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-024-01994-8. Related datasets from this paper: Blood data: SCP3737https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell/study/SCP3737/ Gut CD3 and NK data: SCP3739https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell/study/SCP3739/ Gut CD4 T cell data: SCP3741https://singlecell.broadinstitute.org/single_cell/study/SCP3741/
